external.title: Connect to rustuya-bridge
external.description: The MQTT broker and topic root your running rustuya-bridge uses.

embedded.title: Run rustuya-bridge here
embedded.description: This still connects to a real MQTT broker; it just launches and owns the bridge process itself instead of you running one separately.

devices.title: Device list
devices.description: The tuyadevices.json rustuya-manager keeps. Only the Tuya Cloud login wizard (later in this flow) writes to it; once set up, this integration only reads it. {warning}

data.onboard: Log in to Tuya Cloud and register devices now

cloud_wizard_start.title: Log in to Tuya Cloud
cloud_wizard_start.description: Leave the user code blank for a fresh QR login, or enter a saved one to skip scanning again.

cloud_wizard_scan.title: Scan the QR code
cloud_wizard_scan.description: Scan with the Smart Life or Tuya Smart app, then submit.

sync_devices.title: Sync devices with the bridge
sync_devices.description: Cloud list vs. what the bridge holds: {synced} in sync, {missing} missing from the bridge, {mismatched} with differing settings, {orphaned} on the bridge but not in the cloud list. Every device is listed with its state; nothing is changed unless you select it. {error}

data.update: Update on the bridge (push the cloud's settings)
data.remove: Remove from the bridge (any device it holds)

il.title: IL output
